headline: Stock market starts the day quickly! BIST 100 rises back above 12,000 points
summary: The BIST 100 index of Borsa Istanbul gained 1.27 percent in the first half of trading, reaching 12,098.53 points. Total trading volume amounted to 84.7 billion lira.
why: BIST 100 is the benchmark index of Turkey's main stock exchange, tracking the largest listed Turkish companies.

impacts.name: BIST 100
impacts.why: The benchmark index of Borsa Istanbul rose during the session, as stated in the report.
